//! wow64_automarshal — @generated by `tools/codegen marshal gen`. DO NOT EDIT.
//!
//! 32->64 syscall thunks that wow64gen (stage 1) could not derive from the .spec alone:
//! flat thunks recovered from real header prototypes, and field-copy deep marshallers
//! generated from clang record-layout diffs (32-bit vs 64-bit) through the real header
//! stack. The same walk writes dll/win32/wow64/wow64_automarshal.c, the pre-port C.
//!
//! Regenerate:  tools/codegen marshal gen
//! (requires configured build-arm64/ + build-i386/ for compile_commands.json)

// Each thunk declares its export with the generic 64-bit argument shape, as the C did.
#![allow(clashing_extern_declarations)]

use crate::prelude::WOW64_AUTOMARSHAL_UNIMPL;
use core::ffi::{c_char, CStr};

/// C's `__attribute__((aligned(16)))` on a local byte buffer.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
struct Aligned16<const N: usize>([u8; N]);

#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmCpy(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8, n: usize) {
    core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(s, d, n)
}

#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmZero(d: *mut u8, n: usize) {
    core::ptr::write_bytes(d, 0, n)
}

/// 4 -> 8 sign-extend (covers pointers/handles: guest VAs < 2GB, and pseudo-handles
/// (-1, -2), which are only correct sign-extended).
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmSx(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8) {
    let w = (s as *const i32).read_unaligned() as i64;
    (d as *mut i64).write_unaligned(w)
}

/// 8 -> 4 narrow.
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmNx(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8) {
    WowAmCpy(d, s, 4)
}

/// A leading self-describing size ("cbSize"): the guest states ITS sizeof and the callee
/// compares against the HOST's, so a verbatim copy fails the very version check the field
/// exists for. Rewrite it -- but ONLY when it is exactly the 32-bit sizeof, so a struct
/// with more than one legal size (MONITORINFO vs MONITORINFOEXW) still reaches the kernel
/// with the size the guest actually chose, and a garbage value still gets rejected.
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmSizeIn(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8, g32: u32, h64: u32) {
    let v = (s as *const u32).read_unaligned();
    (d as *mut u32).write_unaligned(if v == g32 { h64 } else { v })
}

/// ...and undo it on the way back: the kernel restamps cbSize with the host sizeof, which
/// would leave the guest holding a size that does not describe its own struct.
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmSizeOut(d: *mut u8, s: *const u8, g32: u32, h64: u32) {
    let v = (s as *const u32).read_unaligned();
    (d as *mut u32).write_unaligned(if v == h64 { g32 } else { v })
}

/// Compare a NUL-terminated name against a literal without a CRT dependency.
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn WowAmStrEq(a: *const c_char, b: &CStr) -> bool {
    for (i, &c) in b.to_bytes_with_nul().iter().enumerate() {
        if *a.add(i) as u8 != c {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}
